claude_proposed_widenings.name: turn_scheduled_effect_sequence
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Storm of Vengeance fires a completely different mechanical effect at the start of each caster turn (turns 1–10). No existing family supports a turn-indexed schedule of distinct resolutions over a concentration spell's duration. This is the dominant structural gap: activation phases fire at cast time; ongoing_effect supports one persistent operation; neither anchored_trigger nor triggered_reaction covers caster-turn-start triggers.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of your later turns, the storm produces different effects, as detailed below. [Turn 2: acid rain; Turn 3: six lightning bolts; Turn 4: hailstones; Turns 5-10: cold + terrain]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: unconditional_damage phase variant for ActivationPhase
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 2 and 4 deal area damage automatically — no saving throw, no attack roll. The current ActivationPhase union only has attack_roll and save_gate. A third variant is needed for area damage that always applies.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Turn 2: 'Acidic rain falls. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 4d6 Acid damage.' Turn 4: 'Hailstones rain down. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage.'

claude_proposed_widenings.name: deafened condition in Condition type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turn 1 applies the Deafened condition on a failed CON save. The Condition type only contains 'prone'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature under the cloud when it appears must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 Thunder damage and have the Deafened condition for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_target_n selection (n distinct creatures) for Attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turn 3 calls six bolts to strike six *different* creatures or objects. The current TargetSelection only supports 'one' or 'choose_up_to' (slot-scaled). A fixed multi-target selection with individual saves per target is not representable.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six different creatures or objects beneath it. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_terrain (difficult terrain area effect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 establish difficult terrain across the storm area. No v4 atom covers terrain modification. block_travel is the closest but it models a wall/barrier, not area-wide movement cost doubling.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, the area is Difficult Terrain...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: heavily_obscured_zone (vision obscurement area effect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turns 5-10 make the area Heavily Obscured. No v4 atom covers area-wide vision obscurement. This is mechanically distinct from block_targeting (which concerns spell targeting, not vision).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...and Heavily Obscured, ranged attacks with weapons are impossible there...
